name: War Drummer
theme: A battle-tested Nordic skald who controls the pace of combat through thunderous drum patterns, strengthens allied formations, disrupts enemy timing, and carries commands across the battlefield.
visualIdentity: Heavy skald garments reinforced for travel, iron-bound war drum, ashwood mallets, fur mantle, bronze fittings, command banners, leather harness, and restrained amber battlefield-rhythm effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, garment silhouette, drum design, mallet design, fur placement, harness arrangement, bronze fittings, and amber, brown, iron, bronze, and charcoal palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Marching Thunder
starterAbilities.description: Drive allies forward with powerful rhythms that improve movement and coordination.

starterAbilities.name: Rallying Cadence
starterAbilities.description: Strengthen nearby allies through battlefield commands and encouraging drumbeats.

starterAbilities.name: Break Their Rhythm
starterAbilities.description: Disrupt enemy coordination and timing through overwhelming percussion.
